newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM unit in venture to build economic zone.
newsitem.headline: RFM unit in venture to build economic zone.

text.p: RFM Properties and Holdings Inc, a unit of food and beverage concern RFM Corp, will be joining hands with Science Park of the Philippines Inc to develop a 133-hectare economic zone south of Manila, according to documents from the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA).
The development of the zone is expected to cost 1.6 billion pesos and will be finished by 2000, the PEZA said.
The Philippine American Life Insurance group and Far East Bank and Trust Co are among major shareholders of Science Park, which currently operates an industrial estate project south of Manila.
No details were available on the equity sharing between Science Park and RFM Properties.
The PEZA said it has approved the project, which will entitle it to fiscal incentives such as duty-free imporat of capital equipment and income tax holidays.
